issues.description: build_date "2026-06-15" (June 15) conflicts with notes.md 编译日期 2026-07-15 (July 15), patch_generation.generated_at '2026-07-15T23:48:42', and metadata.timestamp '2026-07-16'. All evidence points to the actual build date being July 15, not June 15. This appears to be a typo (06 instead of 07).
issues.fix_suggestion: Change build_date from "2026-06-15" to "2026-07-15" to match notes.md and patch_generation timestamps.

issues.description: Code style rule 14 specifies the field name as `name:` (e.g., 'name: zlib'), but this version-level manifest uses `software:` instead. While this may be an intentional format difference for version-level manifests (vs package-level manifests), it deviates from the documented code style standard.
issues.fix_suggestion: If version-level manifests intentionally use `software:`, document this exception. Otherwise, rename to `name:` for consistency with code style rule 14.

issues.description: libudev-zero is a system-level library dealing with netlink (uevent monitoring). Per R40, libraries in the 'system底层: procfs/sysfs/netlink/dl' category require checking for substantive platform adaptation. The test_package only tests udev context management (udev_new/udev_ref/udev_unref) and does not exercise netlink socket functionality. The patches address a header conflict (0002-udev_monitor.c.patch) but the test doesn't cover the netlink code path. Should be marked as '需人工确认适配完整性' (needs manual confirmation of adaptation completeness).
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider adding a test that exercises udev_monitor_new/udev_monitor_enable_receiving to verify netlink socket creation works on OHOS, or document the limitation and mark for manual verification.

issues.description: While `cc` is correctly obtained from Conan conf (self.conf.get("tools.build:compiler_executables")), `ar = "llvm-ar"` and `ranlib = "llvm-ranlib"` are hardcoded string literals. This is not a strict R33 violation (R33 prohibits bare shell env vars like os.environ["CC"]), but hardcoding tool names reduces portability. The `ar` and `ranlib` tools could potentially also be obtained from the Conan conf dict.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider obtaining ar/ranlib from compiler_executables dict (e.g., compiler_executables.get("ar", "llvm-ar")) or document that llvm-ar/llvm-ranlib are the fixed toolchain for HarmonyOS PC.

issues.description: Both patches in patch_classification have guard: 'pending'. Patch 0002-udev_monitor.c.patch uses #ifdef __OHOS__ in its code, so the guard should be '__OHOS__', not 'pending'. The 'pending' status suggests the platform guard classification was not finalized before the PR was created.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set guard to '__OHOS__' for 0002-udev_monitor.c.patch (which uses #ifdef __OHOS__). For 0001-Makefile.patch (which has no ifdef guard, it's an unconditional Makefile change), set guard to 'none' or 'N/A'.

issues.description: Step 7 documents `ohc-run.py finish libudev-zero 1.0.4 published` as the final step, but the actual final status (both in notes.md and manifest.yaml) is 'built', not 'published'. This inconsistency suggests either the publish/upload step was not completed, or the step documentation was written as a planned workflow rather than actual execution results. The manifest honestly reports 'built' status, so this is not deceptive, but the notes are internally inconsistent.
issues.fix_suggestion: Clarify whether step 7 was executed or is a planned step. If the upload was not completed, update step 7 to reflect the actual command run (e.g., `ohc-run.py finish libudev-zero 1.0.4 built`) or add a note explaining that the publish step is pending PR merge.

summary: Audit of libudev-zero 1.0.4 Conan recipe (11 changed files). VERDICT: PASS — no P0 (deceptive behavior) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found. Deception checks all passed: (1) test_package/test.c calls real libudev API (udev_new/udev_ref/udev_unref) — not a stub; (2) test_package/conanfile.py test() calls cmake.test() — not skipped; (3) manifest status='built' is honest and consistent; (4) sha256 is 64 hex chars, not all-zeros/all-f/too-short, field present in both conandata.yml and manifest.yaml; (5) #ifdef __OHOS__ in patch 0002 has substantive logic (sockaddr_storage header conflict workaround) — not a stub; (6) no pre-compiled binaries in PR. Recipe correctness checks passed: R26 static-only build (libudev.a only), R33 compiler from Conan conf, R32 no settings.os== comparisons, R39 official GitHub source URL (tag 1.0.4 verified via API), R37 version matches upstream. Note: sha256 actual value could not be independently verified due to network restrictions (GitHub tarball download failed), but passes all format/anti-faking checks. 6 non-blocking issues found (1 P2, 5 P3): manifest build_date typo (June→July), manifest field naming, R40 netlink test coverage suggestion, hardcoded ar/ranlib, pending patch guards, and notes status inconsistency.
